prompt: A calm wall painting for a baby and toddler room in a Norwegian nursery: a mother moose and her calf standing by a still forest lake at dusk, two ducks on the water, a few birches, soft round hills behind, a big pale moon. Hand-painted gouache and watercolour on paper, very simple soft rounded shapes, mid-century Scandinavian children's book illustration style, gentle and sleepy. Soft muted Nordic palette on warm cream: fjord blue, moss green, heather pink, cloudberry yellow, a touch of lingonberry red. Subtle paper grain. No text, no letters, no border, no frame.
